quotes: Claude Haiku 5.5 supports all five effort levels, and `medium` is the default.
Use `high` for knowledge work, longer agent tasks, and strict instruction following.
In long agent prompts, the model is more likely to skip a search, stop early, or skip a check at `low`.
At `low` and `medium` effort, Claude Haiku 5.5 sometimes reports a code change as done without running a check.
At `xhigh` effort in multi-turn chats, the model sometimes writes its whole answer in its thinking and ends the turn with no visible text.
Claude Haiku 5.5 is the first Haiku model with effort levels.
v2.1.293 | `haiku` resolves to Haiku 5.5 on the Anthropic API
Earlier | ... `haiku` resolves to Haiku 4.5 on every provider

On Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Mantle, an Anthropic model ID with no `modelOverrides` entry resolves to the same provider-specific ID as the `/model` picker row for that version, when the provider supports that version.
model: Model to use: `sonnet`, `opus`, `haiku`, `fable`, a full model ID such as `claude-opus-5-5`, or `inherit`.
